rationale: Iterative largest-normalized-residual test identified inj_b3 as the injected measurement. Initial WLS estimate computed with all 5 measurements showed inj_b3 with normalized residual ~3.2 (exceeding threshold 3.0). After removing inj_b3 and re-estimating with remaining 4 measurements, all normalized residuals fell below threshold. Final corrected state derived from WLS solution with 4 clean measurements.
